answer: Follow the money, not the masks. Keep the ledger crystal-clear about flows, and run constant flow forensics - accounts that consolidate from a common treasury, breathe together at the same hours, and splinter only to claim rewards get clustered automatically. A comet arrival flashing new accounts every epoch cannot hide its basalt-heavy core of shared outflows; clustering itself triggers graduated scrutiny of the whole lattice. Honest agents' funds scatter naturally across the economy and never pattern-match; the net costs little: it reads what the ledger already says.
